title: 宠物友好自驾过夜路线
prompt: 我想带狗自驾出去，最好能住下来，不是当天来回给我地图的路线，以及滑块筛选距离和价格
program:
root = Col([intro, tool, afterText])
$maxDistanceKm = 180
$maxPrice = 800
$selectedStay = ""
intro = Text("下面是一条**带狗自驾过夜**的示例路线：从杭州出发，地图会按筛选后的图钉顺序连接路线；用滑块筛选距离与每晚预算。所有民宿和价格均为演示数据，不生成真实预订。", "md", "muted")
tool = TravelModule([resultLine, sliders, map, selectedNote, Divider(), listTitle, list], "itinerary", "杭州出发 · 带狗自驾过夜路线", "示例数据 · 滑块筛选距离与预算", [resetButton])
afterText = Text("出发前请确认民宿是否接受犬只体型、是否另收清洁费，并准备牵引绳和宠物安全座椅。地图与价格为示例，不构成预订成功；返程请以实时导航为准。", "sm", "muted")
resetButton = Button("重置筛选", @Reset($maxDistanceKm, $maxPrice), "outline", null, "sm", "rotate-ccw")
dist = @Clamp(@Default($maxDistanceKm, 999), 0, 400)
budget = @Clamp(@Default($maxPrice, 9999), 0, 2000)
filteredByDistance = @Filter(stays, "distanceKm", "<=", dist)
filteredStays = @Filter(filteredByDistance, "price", "<=", budget)
count = @Count(filteredStays)
resultLine = Text("符合条件：" + @Plural(count, "家") + " · 距杭州 ≤ " + dist + " km · 每晚 ≤ ¥" + budget + "/晚", "sm", "muted")
sliders = Col([Slider($maxDistanceKm, 50, 300, 10, "距杭州最远距离", "km", [{value: 50, label: "50 km"}, {value: 150, label: "150 km"}, {value: 300, label: "300 km"}]), Slider($maxPrice, 400, 1500, 50, "每晚预算", "元", [{value: 400, label: "¥400"}, {value: 800, label: "¥800"}, {value: 1500, label: "¥1500"}])], 4)
routeMarkers = @Prepend(@Each(filteredStays, "s", MapMarker(s.name, s.lat, s.lng, "stay", "🐾")), MapMarker("杭州出发", 30.2741, 120.1551, "start", "🚗"))
map = Map(routeMarkers, @Count(filteredStays) > 0, $selectedStay, 260)
selectedNote = $selectedStay == "" ? Text("点击地图上的图钉可查看民宿名称，列表会随滑块筛选更新。", "sm", "muted") : Text("已选中：" + $selectedStay + "（示例数据，无实时库存）", "sm", "purple")
listTitle = Title("可住下来 · 宠物友好住宿", "md")
stayRows = @Each(filteredStays, "s", TravelItem(s.name, s.petNote + " · " + s.area, [SearchImage(s.place, 1.33)], [Badge("距杭州 " + s.distanceKm + " km", "purple"), Badge(s.date, "purple"), Price(s.price, "¥", "/晚")]))
list = @Count(filteredStays) == 0 ? Text("没有符合当前距离和预算的示例住宿。试试把滑块调高，或点击“重置筛选”。", "sm", "muted") : Col(stayRows, 4)
stays = [
  {name: "临安·山景木屋", area: "杭州临安", distanceKm: 110, price: 560, petNote: "木屋带小院，近古道", lat: 30.23, lng: 119.72, day: 1, date: "第1晚", place: "临安山景木屋"},
  {name: "莫干山·狗狗友好民宿", area: "湖州德清", distanceKm: 60, price: 680, petNote: "草坪院子，可带中大型犬", lat: 30.61, lng: 119.87, day: 1, date: "第1晚", place: "莫干山民宿"},
  {name: "安吉·竹海露台小院", area: "湖州安吉", distanceKm: 75, price: 820, petNote: "露台有围栏，欢迎宠物", lat: 30.64, lng: 119.68, day: 2, date: "第2晚", place: "安吉竹海民宿"},
  {name: "桐庐·溪边独栋", area: "杭州桐庐", distanceKm: 90, price: 950, petNote: "独栋小院，宠物清洁费已含", lat: 29.79, lng: 119.65, day: 2, date: "第2晚", place: "桐庐溪边民宿"},
  {name: "千岛湖·湖景宠物房", area: "杭州淳安", distanceKm: 140, price: 720, petNote: "湖边步道可遛狗", lat: 29.60, lng: 119.04, day: 2, date: "第2晚", place: "千岛湖湖景民宿"}
]
